name: devops
description: DevOps role pack: the devops-engineer agent /feature dispatches CI, container and infrastructure slices to, pipeline (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI), container (Dockerfile, compose), infra-change (Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm: plan, review, apply with approval, rollback), with their rules. Enabled per repo by core's repo-profile hook; the infra-gate hook lives in ship.
